==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am being surrounded by a swarm of rats. I stomp my way through the swarm. I eventually make my way outside and away from the infestation.

My hair starts floating in the air. My eyes glow red. My nails extend into claws.

I feel a surge of primal energy. I don't know why this is happening to me. I wonder if the rats themselves have somehow changed me.
